headline: RBI: SGB 2021-22 Series I premature redemption price set at ₹12,612 per unit
summary_points: Premature redemption of SGB 2021-22 Series I (issued May 25, 2021) falls due on November 25, 2026.
Redemption price is fixed at ₹12,612 per unit of SGB.
Price is the simple average of IBJA closing gold (999 purity) prices for Nov 19, 20 and 23, 2026.
Premature redemption is allowed after the fifth year from issue, on an interest payment date, under GOI notification F. No. 4(5)-B(W&M)/2021.
who_is_affected: Holders of Sovereign Gold Bonds 2021-22 Series I who are considering premature redemption.
action_required: Eligible holders wishing to redeem early should approach their bank, post office or agency before the due date and confirm the procedure and timelines with the receiving office.

social.linkedin:
RBI has announced the redemption price for premature redemption of Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) 2021-22 Series I.

Key details:
- Premature redemption date: November 25, 2026
- Redemption price: ₹12,612 per unit
- Basis: simple average of IBJA closing price of 999 purity gold for November 19, 20 and 23, 2026

Under the GOI notification F. No. 4(5)-B(W&M)/2021 dated May 12, 2021, premature redemption is permitted after the fifth year from the date of issue, on an interest payment date. This tranche was issued on May 25, 2021.

For advisers and finance teams, this is a useful input when guiding clients or treasury teams on whether to redeem early or hold the bonds to maturity.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1552) before acting.
